keywords: Structure of the cell 2.control of gene expression 3.continuity of life 4.evolution/diversity 5.life-science technology
educationalGoal: During the long evolutionary history of life on Earth, organisms have been modified in many different ways. The human organism is included in this process. The driving force of evolution is diversity. In this course, we will learn about life, the environment and relationships among organisms.
advice: The 21st century has been called the Century of Life Science. Biology is a complex study in a new frame, whether taught by liberal arts faculty or by physical science faculty. We will develop the power to think about the subject rather than place an overemphasis on detailed content knowledge. Elements of the class will include: (1) Structure and functions of life (2) The continuity of life (3) Response and regulation in organisms (4) Organisms and their environment (5) Life-science technology and society Classes will be conducted using various methods: lectures, seminars, video viewing or a combination of these.
